concerns.text: FR-002 specifies `Salesforce/codegen-mono`, but the source idea and Constitution Principle VII mandate `Salesforce/codegen-350M-mono`. The Assumptions section compounds this with a third variant, `Salesforce/codegen`. Pick the exact idea-specified model identifier everywhere; the constitution states any deviation invalidates the paired analysis.

FR-002 and US-2 say only 'fixed low temperature setting'. The idea and Constitution Principle VII pin temperature = 0.2 as a hard requirement for statistical validity. The spec drops this concrete value — restore it (or explicitly defer it with the metric named, not silently vague).
The sentence-transformers model is inconsistently named: `all-MiniLM-L-v2` in US-3/FR-004/Assumptions vs `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` in SC-003 and the idea. Standardize on the idea's `all-MiniLM-L6-v2`.
